user.title: Assist fallback responses
user.description: Phrases that Assist answers when a command could not be completed as expected.

data_description.responses: One phrase per line. Start a line with a language code to use the phrase only for that language, for example "en: Something went wrong". Lines without a language code are used for every language.
data_description.include_defaults: Adds the phrases shipped with this integration, in the language of the request, to your own phrases.
